ValidationRule.description: Lock Agreement record from being edited while agreement is in Pending Approvals, Activated, In Signature, Expired or Terminated
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF(AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Apttus__Status_Category__c),'In Filing')), OR( TEXT(Apttus_Approval__Approval_Status__c) = 'Pending Approval', TEXT( Apttus__Status__c ) = 'Activated', TEXT( Apttus__Status_Category__c ) = 'In Signatures', TEXT( Apttus__Status_Category__c ) = 'Expired', TEXT( Apttus__Status_Category__c ) = 'Terminated'), OR( ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId), ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED(Apttus__Account__c), ISCHANGED(APTS_Internal_Legal_Entity__c), ISCHANGED( APTS_Type_of_Paper__c ), ISCHANGED(APTS_Governing_Law__c), ISCHANGED(Apttus__Description__c), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), ISCHANGED( Apttus__Requestor__c ), ISCHANGED( Apttus__Contract_Start_Date__c ), ISCHANGED( Apttus__Contract_End_Date__c ), ISCHANGED( Apttus__Perpetual__c ), ISCHANGED( Apttus__Auto_Renewal__c ), ISCHANGED( Apttus__Term_Months__c ), ISCHANGED( APTS_Term_Years__c ), ISCHANGED( APTS_Payment_Terms__c ), ISCHANGED( Apttus__Owner_Expiration_Notice__c ), ISCHANGED( Apttus__Amendment_Effective_Date__c ), ISCHANGED( Apttus__Auto_Renew_Term_Months__c ), ISCHANGED( Apttus__Auto_Renewal_Terms__c ), ISCHANGED( Apttus__Renewal_Notice_Days__c ), ISCHANGED( Apttus__Request_Date__c ), ISCHANGED( Apttus__Total_Contract_Value__c ), ISCHANGED( APTS_Confidentiality_of_affiliate__c), ISCHANGED( APTS_Governing_Law__c), ISCHANGED( APTS_Other_Governing_Law__c), ISCHANGED( APTS_Language__c), ISCHANGED( APTS_Type_of_Paper__c), ISCHANGED( Apttus__Description__c), ISCHANGED( APTS_Solution_Fields__c), ISCHANGED( Apttus__Total_Contract_Value__c), ISCHANGED( APTS_Payment_Terms__c), ISCHANGED( APTS_Other_Payment_Term__c), ISCHANGED( APTS_Limitation_of_Liability__c), ISCHANGED( APTS_Limitation_of_Liability_Description__c), ISCHANGED( APTS_Liability_Type_Slight_Amount__c), ISCHANGED( APTS_Liability_Type_Gross_Amount__c), ISCHANGED( APTS_IP_Indemnification__c), ISCHANGED( Apttus__Termination_Notice_Days__c) )), TRUE, FALSE)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Agreement information cannot be changed while in Approvals/In Signatures or after Activation, Expiration, Termination.
